summary: Military aircraft carrying out high energy manoeuvres within 5 nautical miles of Plymouth, between 3,000 and 20,000 feet above sea level.
text:
AIR EXER. WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEUVRES IN SUPPORT OF 
GROUND OPS WI 5NM RADIUS OF 502149N 0040806W (PLYMOUTH). ACFT MAY 
OPERATE AT SPEEDS OF UP TO 450 KNOTS IAS AND MAY BE UNABLE TO COMPLY 
WITH RAC. FOR FURTHER INFO AIC Y007/2023 REFERS. FOR INFO
07564 564308 / 07817 765185. AR-2026-10554/01.
